title.en: Property tax - new assessment / name transfer
title.ta: சொத்து வரி - புதிய மதிப்பீடு / பெயர் மாற்றம்
title.hi: संपत्ति कर - नया मूल्यांकन / नाम परिवर्तन
title.or: ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି କର - ନୂଆ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ / ନାମ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ

description.en: Get a new property assessed for tax, or move the tax record to the new owner's name.
description.ta: புதிய சொத்துக்கு வரி மதிப்பீடு பெற, அல்லது வரிப் பதிவை புதிய உரிமையாளர் பெயருக்கு மாற்ற.
description.hi: नई संपत्ति का कर मूल्यांकन कराएं, या कर रिकॉर्ड नए मालिक के नाम करें।
description.or: ନୂଆ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତିର କର ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ କରାନ୍ତୁ, ବା କର ରେକର୍ଡ ନୂଆ ମାଲିକଙ୍କ ନାମରେ କରନ୍ତୁ।

submit_note: Apply on the Corporation's online portal or at the zonal/revenue office. For a name transfer, apply soon after registration - the old owner's name stays on the bill until you do.

fields.explain: New assessment is for a newly built property that has never been taxed. Name transfer is when you bought or inherited a property that is already taxed.

question.en: What is the current property tax assessment number? (on the old tax receipt)

fields.explain: The number on the existing property tax receipt.

question.en: What is the full address of the property?

fields.explain: Door number, street, area and city of the property.

question.en: Which zone and ward is the property in? (say 'skip' if you don't know)

fields.explain: The Corporation zone and ward number. It is on old tax receipts; the office can tell you if you don't know.
Commercial use is taxed at a higher rate.

question.en: Do you live in it yourself, or is it rented out?

fields.explain: Rented-out properties can be taxed differently from owner-occupied ones.

question.en: What is the plinth (built-up) area in square feet?

fields.explain: The built-up floor area of the building.

question.en: Which year was the building completed?

fields.explain: Older buildings get a depreciation reduction in many cities.

question.en: What is the registered document number of your sale/gift deed? (like 1234/2025)

fields.explain: The number given by the Sub-Registrar office when your deed was registered.
Date on which the deed was registered.

documents: EB card / bill (some offices ask for it)
